title_en: Thoughts on the Memory Sector and Latest Developments
sections: I've never quantified how large the memory supply–demand gap actually is before. This time I'll walk through a rough quantified result from financial modeling, as a reference point. Meanwhile, Nvidia's latest earnings once again confirm how critical and urgent the memory situation is: supply constraints are forcing Nvidia's FY28 revenue growth to be capped at 70%.
